I enjoy turning data into decisions — building machine learning models,
interactive dashboards, and NLP pipelines that bridge analytical rigour with
real-world business impact.

## About Me

I'm an **MSc Business Analytics** student at **Dublin City University**, with
an undergraduate degree in **B.Tech Information Technology**. My focus sits at
the intersection of data science and strategic decision-making — turning
complex datasets into clear, actionable insights.

My work spans machine learning pipelines, interactive dashboards, and applied
NLP. I'm particularly interested in how analytical methods can drive better
business outcomes.
